5.3K views · 191 reactions | NIGER HAS ITS URANIUM. SO WHY CAN'T IT SELL IT?

Niger has taken control of its uranium, but a major challenge remains: getting it to market.

Legal restrictions, international arbitration and the difficulties of exporting from a landlocked country have complicated the picture.

So here's the question: what is the value of uranium sitting in storage if it cannot reach paying customers?

Resource independence requires more than ownership. It requires the power to sell, transport and benefit from what a country produces.
